lines.en: I spot Maya shortly after arriving at the shrine and make my way over to her.
It’s still suspiciously warm around here (For reasons I’ve yet to understand), but it seems that she’s taken up shelter in a booth with her back to a pair of large glowing lanterns.
I can feel their heat from here, which is great considering her gaze is ice cold.
Here’s hoping they thaw her out sometime soon.
: Yo.
: What’s up?
: Are you ignoring me now?
: I’m conserving energy.
: Are you about to go into hibernation for the rest of the winter or something?
: I wish.
: What do you need to conserve energy for?
: Daily activities. Getting out of bed. Brushing my teeth.
: An overabundance of stress from having to put up with you all the time.
: The usual.
: Is there an extra spot inside of that booth? There’s this one girl who keeps bossing me around and it’s getting to me as well.
: Stop saying that I’m bossing you around. I haven’t asked you to do a single thing today.
: I mean...I just got here.
: And I got the message loud and clear the other night.
: You’re not going to ignore Noriko, so I’m just going to have to figure out a new way to deal with that.
: If you wind up disappearing, though, don’t say I didn’t warn you.
: I mean...you wouldn’t be able to say anything because you disappeared. But you know what I mean.
: It’s not like she has anything interesting to tell you anyway. Your old life was boring and sad.
: You get really grumpy when you’re stressed, huh?
: I’m hungry, too. But I have to hang out at this stupid shrine and pretend there is a god.
: It’s quite taxing.
: Just leave if you hate it here that much.
: Let’s go get lunch or something.
: Together?
: Maya, we’ve eaten together several times.
: Not lunch, though.
: We’ve always gone out late at night so I wouldn’t feel weird about anyone seeing us together.
: And I was only fine with Uta seeing us because, until recently, I didn’t think it was possible for fate to get so out of sorts that she’d wind up several desks away from me.
: And even though all we did was eat, I now have to face her constant accusations about us being boyfriend and shrine maiden.
: Why not just say “boyfriend and girlfriend?”
: I was about to, but I got nauseous.
: I figured as much.
: I wouldn’t worry if I were you, though.
: I’m pretty sure that everyone knows we’re not romantically involved by now.
: Yeah...I don’t really know if that’s exactly true anymore.
: What do you mean?
: I mean that my...reaction to Noriko’s appearance in class has caused some people to second guess the nature of our relationship.
: Really?
: Well, I guess this means we have to start dating.
: Please don’t joke about things like that.
: Until now, I managed to fly completely under the radar and not get wrapped up in any of your senseless hidden romance drama.
: Now, even Ayane is accusing me of having feelings for you. And I hate seeing Ayane act serious. It’s unsettling.
: Yeah...that doesn’t happen often, does it?
: The point is...it’s important, now more than ever, for the two of us to maintain distance.
: Ever? In all of the gajillion years we’ve known each other?
: First off, that’s not even a real number.
: Secondly, don’t get into semantics with me.
: When someone says “now more than ever” it very rarely means “now more than ever.”
: It just means that it’s extremely important. Which it is.
: The two of us are not to be seen out and about with one another. There is far too much at stake.
: This has been a rule for a very long time, Sensei. You should be fully aware of it by now.
: I never really thought of it as a “rule.” I just figured that’s how you are.
: And in thinking that, you are exactly right.
: I’m cold and blunt. A kuudere with slowly dissipating “cool” and “dere” buried somewhere so far underground that you’ll likely never find it.
Yeah, I'm pretty sure I found it when she almost [rape]d me the other night.
: The “dere” part exists?
: That was mostly a joke. You weren’t meant to take it seriously.
: Too late. I need to go buy a shovel.
: See you, Maya.
: You’re disgusting.
: That may very well be true, but I’m not the one under suspicion, now am I?
: What are you talking about? You’re literally always under suspicion.
: Any of those poor girls who think you’re not two...three...or ten-timing them are just choosing to be ignorant about it.
: And yet you’re the one Ayane is apparently questioning.
: Oh please. As if she hasn’t questioned you as well.
: What did you tell her? That you can’t promise to be with only her but that she’s still extremely important to you or blah blah blah?
: Wow. You really are grouchy today.
: The grouchiest.
: I can’t remember the last time I actually had to think this much. It’s putting me on edge.
: Well I personally like this side of you.
: It feels like we’re getting somewhere.
: This is your idea of getting somewhere? Slightly more facial expressions and openly confronting you about your relationships with my friends?
: Sure. We’re talking about things I can finally understand.

: You understand all of the other stuff we talk about as well. You just choose to act aloof about it because the second a theory starts sitting in your head, it becomes too real and you want to run away.
: It’s just how your brain is wired.
: Mine is the same way, but with less pent up sexual aggression and more quantum theory and food.
: Trivia time. Which of the two participants in this conversation has mounted the other in an effort to coerce them into sex?
: Stop bringing that up!
: I'm just countering your whole thing about not being sexually aggressive when my personal experiences prove otherwise.
: That didn't count! It was an act of desperation, not sexual aggression!
: I'm done talking about this!
: Is there any sexual aggression in there at all?
: Up until now, I’ve gotten a really intense asexual vibe from you.
: Good. Please continue to think that. I’m not open to discussing those sorts of things.
: You’re such a buzzkill.
: How? You have half a classroom worth of girls who you’re likely sleeping with already. Talk to one of them about that if you truly need to.
: I’ll continue to sit inside this booth and think about clouds.
: Okay, so let’s say that...theoretically, I am sleeping with some of the girls.
: How would that make you feel?
: What is this?
: Are you trying to get me to say I’m jealous?
: I’m searching for the “dere.”
: Hah...
: I’d feel the same exact way I’ve felt all along.
: You’re a horrible person with a disgusting addiction and an affinity for girls well under the age you should be setting your sights on.
: And even though I think that side of you is despicable and wish it would go away...I don’t hold it against anyone.
: Well, maybe I do hold it against you. But not any of them.
: They’re just normal girls who are blissfully unaware that they’re caught in a loop.
: Falling for version after version of the same [high_school] teacher but failing to truly capture him each and every time.
: It’s actually quite sad...watching them bend and break so many times.
: Wait, what happened to their memories persisting through resets? What’s all this about bending and breaking?
: Perhaps you’ll find out in due time?
: Unless, of course, you wind up poking your nose deeper into the past and get your slate wiped clean again.
: Are you saying that once I’m gone, they’ll be gone too?
: Is that what you think?
: I’ve given up on thinking when it comes to getting all deep and introspective like this.
: Boy, do I wish I could do that.
: Take a moment and think back to when you first arrived here.
: Everyone already had preconceived notions of the type of person you were, correct?
: Yeah. But wasn’t that just because that’s how the original Sensei was?
: Interesting theory.
: I can see why you’d think something like that.
: But you’re wrong.
: What you were witnessing in those moments were their memories being rewritten.
: Didn’t you think it was strange how quickly some of them warmed up to you despite undergoing a complete switch in personalities?
: How everyone just decided that not actually being taught anymore was a totally normal thing?
: Are you familiar with computers? I want to make a comparison, but I’m not sure if you’ll understand.
: Feel free. I’m already lost, so any comparison at all could possibly help.
: Computers don’t have brains like humans do. They have hard drives.
: Over time, those hard drives fill up with information a user collects and saves.
: If a household only has one computer and every resident of the house uses it, that storage space will begin to fill up rather quickly.
: So, in order to make space for new information, old information needs to be deleted.
: Or reformatted entirely in more severe cases.
: What you were experiencing in watching those girls adapt to you was a type of reformatting.
: They were freeing up space in their minds to make room for the “new” you.
: And unless you do something to ruin them, which you likely will since you are horrible, that will be how they remain until a new user comes along.
: Do you understand?
: I think so...but...
: But what?
: Why the fuck did you take so long to tell me this?
: Because I needed you to fail to a certain extent.
: And you failed wonderfully.
: Good job, Sensei.
: I really wish you didn’t go all the way with Ami, though.
: I hate watching her get hurt after everything that she’s been through.
: You...
: Did you really think you would be able to hide that from me?
: Or, scratch that, did you really think Ami would be able to hide that from me?
: We’re both [teenage]girls at the end of the day.
: You are...surprisingly unfazed by this.
: Oh, I judge you harshly for it.
: I’m just used to it by now.
: Accepting your shortcomings and flaws is something I will never find joy in, but something I must do nonetheless.
: Expecting you to make it through an entire loop without manipulating one of the girls into sex acts is like expecting me to not make it through without...
: What is something weird or bad that I do?
: You talk about the sky a lot.
: Yes, that. It’s like expecting me to make it through a loop without bringing up the sky.
: The key difference is that my crutch doesn’t hurt anyone and yours hurts everyone.
: Just not right away.
: It definitely hurts some of them right away.
: Why do you always have to ruin everything?
: Just because I know about what you’re doing with everyone doesn’t mean I want to hear about it.
: Have some respect.
: I will. Because even though you allegedly know what I allegedly do in all of my alleged spare time...
: You still haven’t done anything to make me pay for it.
: What would I do? I’m just a normal [teenage]girl.
: I don’t know. But I’m glad it’s nothing.
: Either way...I’ll see if I can talk to the others about how there’s definitely nothing going on between us.
: Yeah. Thanks.
: That would be a big help.
Maya and I remain situated at the booth for a little while longer.
The sun retreats behind the clouds, creating a darkness that swallows me whole.
Maya remains safe, illuminated by the glow of her giant lanterns as I am left to figure out where to go from here.
I learned a lot more than I normally do with Maya today.
In fact, for the first time ever, I might be leaving with more answers than questions.
I should probably cherish this moment.
But for some reason-
I just keep worrying about her.
Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!
